title: vObywatel
tagline: Create and manage a smart account using government issued credentials
description: vObywatel allows for the issuance of smart accounts backed by government-issued credentials generated from services such as mObywatel, ePUAP, and other *.gov.pl domains. The smart account generation is initiated using a premade account. Once done, we can use it with our preferred signer to send transactions.
how_its_made: This project uses vlayer's web proofs to create proofs of credential issuance from government services. We use a SmartAccountFactory contract to gate SmartAccount creation behind web-proof verification. Each new account is guaranteed to be made only after ownership of a specific government id hash is proved.
